project_metadata.title: INFO/POLIS - Digital Interactive Magazine on AI Disinformation in Brazilian Elections
project_metadata.aspect_ratio: 1440x1024 fixed frames floating over dark graphite backdrop

body_backdrop.description: Neutral body backdrop over which individual 1440x1024 magazine frames float with deep ambient shadows

font_families.headline: Archivo, sans-serif
font_families.accent_style: Italic / Regular for quotes, subtitles, and sociological definitions

h3.usage: Box headings, card titles, section eyebrows

small.usage: Metadata, figure captions, chart tags, value pills

strict_alignment_rules.alignment: ALL text MUST be left-aligned (text-left). Absolutely no center-aligned text.
strict_alignment_rules.side_gutter: 96px (px-24 / px-[96px]) uniform margin on all 1440x1024 frames.

layout_architecture.frame_dimensions: 1440px x 1024px fixed aspect ratio sections centered on screen
layout_architecture.outer_container: bg-[#121214] py-12 flex flex-col items-center gap-16 overflow-x-hidden
layout_architecture.alternating_pattern: Frame 1 (Dark Cover) -> Frame 2 (Light Editorial) -> Frame 3 (Dark Data/Charts) -> Frame 4 (Light Sociological concepts) -> Frame 5 (Dark Deepfake Showcase) -> Frame 6 (Light Conclusion)

instructions_to_main_agent: Load Google Fonts 'Archivo' (weights 400, 600, 800) and 'Newsreader' (italics and regular) in index.html or App.css.
Implement the fixed 1440x1024 floating card container layout over dark graphite #121214 background.
Strictly follow left-alignment for ALL text elements across all frames.
Ensure side gutter of exactly 96px (px-24) inside each SectionFrame component.
Implement alternating dark (#0F0F10) and light (#F4F1EA) section frames.
Integrate kinetic title text reveal for 'INFO/POLIS' at ~168px scale.
Include the interactive data charts, duotone image hover effects, stat cards with count-up, expandable RevealPanels, and sticky reading nav with TOC drawer.
Attach data-testid attributes to all interactive elements, frame sections, buttons, and navigation controls.
